name: Forest floor
text: Plain ground with no intensity. Creatures nearby change it; on its own it only grows things that need nothing.

name: Stony ground
text: Stone pushes spikes of rock up through the grass: gravel at first, tall spires at its strongest.

name: Dug earth
text: Depth opens patches of bare earth with roots, and burrow holes as it deepens. It hides things underground.

name: Damp ground
text: Damp darkens and soaks the grass, from dew to puddles. Water slowly seeps outward and runs downhill.

name: Glowing ground
text: Glow scatters motes and glowing moss. Faint by day, bright at night, and bright in deep ground even by day.

name: Flowering ground
text: Bloom fills the grass with flowers that open in the morning, peak at midday and close at dusk.

name: Lush grass
text: Verdure thickens the grass into tall growth where small things can hide.

name: Shallow pool
text: Where Damp gathers in dug ground it pools into shallow water, joined into ponds with neighbouring pools.

name: Mossy bank
text: Stone, Damp and Verdure together grow moss over ground and rock, and bugs gather there.

name: Wild meadow
text: Bloom and Verdure together make a tangle of flowers in long grass, where plants grow fast.

name: Treeline
text: The dense forest around your clearing. Nothing grows there for you yet; the clearing pushes it back as your land develops.
